'''December 2001 Ventura tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Ralphs comics, Ventura on 1 December 2001. It is known from Wilson Fisher's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3132">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-01-a-real-tournament-report-ventura-12-1d3132/ a-real-tournament-report-ventura-12-1], DeckTech (Wilson "Your mom" Fisher, 1 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-01-a-real-tournament-report-ventura-12-1d3132/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Ralphs comics, Ventura
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Sanchez]]<ref name="tr-d3137" />
